rules.base: ITEM_DOOR_<class>_CLOSED:ALL or ITEM_HATCH_COVER_<class>_CLOSED:1; independent of tested quality

rules.blend: Engine-independent blendOver: transparent destination copies source; otherwise output alpha=srcA+floor(dstA*(255-srcA)/255), RGB=floor((srcRGB*srcA+floor(dstRGB*dstA*(255-srcA)/255))/outputA). Both layers palette-swapped first; glass confirms partially transparent destinations.
